secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DERIV_APP_ID
secrets.description: Deriv App ID from the App Registration dashboard (https://developers.deriv.com/dashboard/). Required for OAuth login and trading; the app renders live charts without it.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DERIV_REDIRECT_URI
secrets.description: OAuth redirect URI registered with the Deriv app. For this preview use https://3000-<BASE44_PUBLIC_HOST_SUFFIX>. Required for OAuth login.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DERIV_APP_NAME
secrets.description: In-app display name (header, tab title, favicon). Optional; defaults to 'EPITOME TRADERS'.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DERIV_REFERRAL_LINK
secrets.description: Affiliate referral link shown to unauthenticated users. Optional.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DERIV_ENV
secrets.description: Deriv environment: 'production' (live endpoint) or 'preview' (staging). Optional; defaults to production.
